note: Committed selection rules read by scripts/select_lambda.py and scripts/select_alpha.py (lane L-AM16-ALPHA; the selection contract in docs/lane_specs/part2.md). The lambda grid, band, seed, iterations and default candidate, and the alpha grid, default, default candidate and iterations must agree with configs/distill.py; src/training/sweep_select.py refuses a disagreement.

lambda_logit.value: best_val_miou_all_class: the run's best-checkpoint VAL all-class mIoU (strict >, earliest tie, as E1)
lambda_logit.shortfall: refused, naming AM-17 item 9: selection among the finished candidates at the TEST freeze (shortfall disclosed) is not implemented, so no selection is made; a diverged non-default candidate is not a shortfall: its directory is supplied and it is excluded (AM-7a)

alpha_cwd.value: best_val_miou_all_class: the run's best-checkpoint VAL all-class mIoU

band.rule: band = max(floor, sqrt(2) * s); s = sample SD (n = 3) of E1's best VAL all-class mIoU over seeds 42, 43, 44

alpha_cwd.shortfall: refused (lane 2 STOP: fewer than three finished runs); a cut sweep means alpha = 50 and no selection file (AM-16); a diverged non-default candidate is not a shortfall: its directory is supplied and it is excluded (AM-7a)
